$description: Dark theme overrides, merged over color.semantic.json at build time. Palette from ST-148 (Nocturne): the Study Room after dark, lit by one lamp. Replaces the unwired Rapid slate/periwinkle draft.

page.$description: Warm lamplit black. The board stays the brightest object on screen.

primary.$description: Bone. 15:1 on the page; survives AAA on all three surfaces.

muted.$description: Muted bone at 7:1+, so muted never means illegible.

on-accent.$description: Near-black labels on ember fills: dark-on-warm reads printed, not neon.

default.$description: Terracotta lifted to ember. 5:1+ as body text, so one token serves fills and text.

link.$description: Link ember at 7:1+; the underline stays the mandatory second channel.

info.$description: Candle gold for coach notes and annotations; distinct from the ember accent under colour-vision simulation.

ring.$description: Teal lift: 9:1 on the page and never reads as selection.
